priority: P1 — verificar rotação física A1→B1→A2→B2 no laboratório 2v2 normal: cada mão/Deck continua pertencendo ao assento físico, somente o assento ativo pode agir, a restauração JSON preserva o próximo ator e a projeção pública não revela UIDs privados.

behavior.seats: Four physical seats; alternating teams; initial seat may be any of 0, 1, 2 or 3.
behavior.rotation: A1 → B1 → A2 → B2; each incoming physical seat draws from its own Deck and retains its own private hand.
behavior.persistence: A JSON round-trip occurs after every turn; assertTagDuel and the next decision must remain valid.
behavior.authorization: tagActions returns legal actions only for the active physical seat.
behavior.publicProjection: publicTagDuel exposes counts and public field state only; hand/Deck UIDs are redacted.

testCoverage: Verifies the fixture contains ten distinct certified low-level Normal monsters, three copies each, and a legal 30-card Main Deck.
Runs the four starting-seat permutations and executes four End Phases per permutation.
Snapshots all four physical hands and Deck orders before each rotation; only the incoming seat may receive the draw.
Verifies inactive physical seats receive no legal actions.
Restores JSON after every turn and revalidates the TagDuel state, active seat, and private hand/Deck ownership.
Checks the public projection never contains private hand or Deck arrays or physical card UIDs.
Rejects effect monsters in the Normal laboratory, Main Decks outside 20–30, and Extra Decks above five.

security.database: No database import or writes; pure in-memory TagDuel state
security.discord: Engine/projection contract offline; no token, guild or channel

limitations: No live Discord Client or guild interaction.
This is a rules/persistence regression suite, not a new card certification.
No local runtime execution in this run; remote CI is the acceptance gate.
validationNotes: Primeira CI: 4 cenários de rotação chegaram corretamente ao fim dos quatro turnos, mas a asserção final esperava que ambas as equipes voltassem à posição inicial simultaneamente.
Correção do teste: a rotação mantém, para cada equipe, o último assento que atuou até o próximo turno daquela equipe; agora a matriz verifica o mapeamento esperado após cada turno e o cursor físico.
Nenhuma alteração de runtime foi necessária; os outros quatro cenários focados passaram na primeira execução.
